title: Add native <search> tag
body:
Adds the native `<search>` element to the compiler's HTML taglib and to the `Marko.NativeTags` types.

`<slot>` is left out: since this PR was opened, the compiler deliberately rejects `<slot>` with a hint pointing at dynamic tags (`<${input.content}/>`), which a native `<slot>` would bypass. A new test pins where the compilable native tags and `Marko.NativeTags` deliberately differ, so a tag added to only one of them fails.
